prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Atlanta for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t name a single “best” dentist for implants in Atlanta — that depends on your exact needs (single tooth vs full-arch, bone grafts needed, sedation preferences, budget) — but I can help you find one who’s right for you. Here’s how to identify top implant providers in Atlanta and what to ask at a consultation.

Who to look for
- Oral and maxillofacial surgeons and periodontists: they place implants and manage complex surgical needs (bone grafts, sinus lifts). 
- Prosthodontists: specialists at restoring the implant with a crown/bridge or full-arch prosthesis — important for esthetic or complex restorations.
- Dentists who offer a team approach (surgeon + prosthodontist) for predictable results.

Where to search
- Professional organizations’ directories: American Association of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgeons (AAOMS), American Academy of Periodontology (AAP), American Academy of Implant Dentistry (AAID), and the American College of Prosthodontists.
- Local reviews and before/after photos: Google, Yelp, Healthgrades. Check the practice website for case galleries.
- Georgia State Board of Dentistry to verify license and any disciplinary history.

Key credentials and technology to prefer
- Specialty training (Oral Surgery, Periodontics, Prosthodontics) or extensive implant experience.
- Use of CBCT (3D imaging) for planning.
- Guided-surgery/digital planning capability for precise placement.
- Collaboration with a prosthodontist when needed.
- Clear documentation of complication rates and follow-up care.

Questions to ask at a consult
- How many implants do you place per year? How many similar cases have you done?
- Are you board-certified or a specialist? What is your training in implants?
- Do you use CBCT and digital planning/guided surgery?
- Who will do the implant placement and who will make the final crown? Do you work with a prosthodontist?
- What implant system do you use and why?
- What is your success/complication rate and how do you handle complications?
- What is the total estimated cost (placement + abutment + crown) and payment/financing options?
- What sedation/anesthesia options are available?
- Can I see before/after photos and patient references?

Red flags
- No before/after photos or inability to describe similar cases
- Unclear about who does the restorative work
- Pushes highest-priced options without clear rationale
- No follow-up care or guarantees

Cost ballpark
- A single implant with final crown in the U.S. commonly runs roughly $2,500–$6,000+, depending on complexity (bone grafts, sinus lift, implant brand, lab work). Prices vary widely — get a written estimate.

If you want, tell me:
- your ZIP or neighborhood in Atlanta,
- whether it’s a single tooth, multiple, or full-arch,
- any preferences (sedation, timing, budget),

and I’ll compile a short list of well-reviewed Atlanta specialists and practices you can consider.
